svg.title: One process owns the store
svg.desc: An application, agent or CLI runs the relate engine inside its own process, with the whole graph in memory. The engine writes each commit to the store on disk, a single .rl file or a directory. Another process can open a directory store read-only beside the writer. Bolt, HTTP and MCP clients reach the engine through one relate serve process.
